title: the 60cc bounce proof's live ask is marked as testing
intention: The 60cc bounce proof's live ask for an undeclared verb carries a perform testing mark, so the tester's bounce disposes of its trouble instead of raising a live one.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: the live trouble mail-tester-has-no-verb-no-such-verb-60cc220da787 holds 7 occurrences raised by TesterShim from sender a_bounce_answers_60cc. Tooth 2 of test_a_bounce_answers_the_request_that_bore_it.py asks the live tester with body {}, and the shim raises a trouble for every unmarked bounce (b3386f431ae3).
traces_to: Law 7: the trouble lane is a record of truth, and test debris there crowds out real errors. ad7caca4d54c intended every body a test sends marked as testing.
how: Tooth 2's request body becomes {testing_mark.FIELD: testing_mark.mark('60cc220da787', testing_mark.PERFORM)}. It is a perform mark because _return_if_marked returns a return-kind body unacted on, before the verb. A red-first proof wraps the bus client and records the ask and its reply.
